subject: bamboo
name: 竹子
label: 交错的竹枝
learning: 先观察主体各部分怎样连接，再挑几处有特点的细节。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. MEDIUM reference: an elegant observational picture-book drawing with a clear coherent silhouette, 6–10 separated distinguishing structural details and natural joined parts. Richer form than an icon, without intricate texture or dense repeated marks. Two bamboo stems of different heights crossing gently, clearly spaced nodes and three graceful leaf fans, no forest background.
Black ink contour drawing with white background and white interiors, no solid leaf fills or gray shading. Keep leaves broad, no repeated fine texture. Center complete subject in central 75 percent of canvas with ample margins, clearly connected branching structure.
